critical_code_review_comments: Fixed inline: frontend /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx line 180 had outer <Pressable> testID={`vacancy-${item.id}-${item.slot_index || 0}`} which, now that backend no longer emits slot_index, would have collapsed to `vacancy-{jobId}-0` for every sibling slot of a multi-slot job → testID collisions and inconsistent with the new spec. Corrected to `vacancy-${item.vacancy_key || item.id}` to match the Apply button and the review-request spec.
